research_question: On every baseline-failure case in the fixed cross-method census that has no prior Minimal-B F+O+R outcome, does repeatable same-session target-state replay improve paired EnvBench Official Pass@1 over a fresh goal-aware free Agent using the same model?

rule: Include a case when Codex native or Repo2Run has a scientifically attributable failure or candidate noncompletion in the fixed cross-method census.
Exclude every case with any prior F+O+R Minimal-B episode: conan-package-tools, pyrollbar, langgraph, geoapps, sphinx-gallery, and nonebot2.
Exclude jaraco/irc because Codex, prior EnvSolve-Pro, and Repo2Run all passed Official.
Include all nine remaining cases in source-census order; do not rank by difficulty, expected repairability, repository contents, or any current A/B outcome.
selection.interpretation: All identities are consumed development evidence, but the current Minimal-B treatment is unopened on every selected identity. This study selects a development method; it is not held-out evaluation.

A_FO.description: One unrestricted continuous Agent session with ordinary execution feedback and the complete public goal; no target-state replay action.

B_FOR.description: The same continuous Agent interface plus an Agent-invoked repeatable clean replay. Replay failures return to the same session, and final delivery requires the exact replay-passing program. There is no scheduled observation, forced handoff, checkpoint, cross-case memory, or harness-selected repair.

shared: DeepInfra through OpenRouter with fallbacks disabled
complete public goal and initial repository information
shared minimal evaluator and repository integrity boundary
fresh source checkout and EnvBench Official evaluator
broad request, command, wall-time, and provider-retry safety limits

execution.matching: Fresh A and B rollouts use the same requested seed within each pair. Provider rollouts remain stochastic.
execution.order: Alternate A-first and B-first by source-census position.
execution.host_rule: Both arms of a pair run on the same host; host effects cannot create a within-pair treatment contrast.

endpoints.primary: Paired EnvBench Official Pass@1 over every scientifically eligible pair, with valid non-submission counted as failure.
mechanism: replay invocation count and status sequence
endpoints.failure_analysis: Every scientifically valid failure receives an earliest decisive Observation, Constraint, or Operation label plus secondary mechanism tags.

analysis.statistics: Report the exact paired discordance table and two-sided exact McNemar result. Statistical significance is evidence, not an algorithm-selection gate.
analysis.resources: Report unconditionally and on common-success pairs. Resource use is an outcome, not a hard threshold.
analysis.infrastructure: Censor recognized infrastructure failures. Permit one exact-script, evaluation-only retry when preregistered infrastructure policy applies; never rerun the model for an Official-only retry.
analysis.whole_batch_rule: Do not change the algorithm, prompt, replay semantics, integrity boundary, case set, model, or provider policy after any episode outcome. Complete and adjudicate the full batch before interpretation.

claim_boundary: This study can select or reject Minimal B as the fixed development method and estimate a development stress-test effect on the recorded failure stratum.
It cannot establish held-out performance, population success rate, leaderboard performance, statistical significance, generalization, or SOTA.
No case-specific package rule, checkpoint, cross-case memory, candidate-retention policy, scheduled observation, forced handoff, or new gate may be derived during the batch.
